newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 11.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 11.

text.p: All Mexican ports were reported open Friday, Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies with winds still stronger along the northern coast, about 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and waves five to eight feet high.

A warm front heading west-northwest could bring light rains to coast. Winds moderate from east and southeast from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves four to eight feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with some rains and winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
